title: Orlando Lake Tours
specs: Butler Chain of Lakes covers almost 5000 acres with 13 lakes linked by canals
Wildlife includes alligators, osprey, blue heron, snowy egret, bald eagles, pelicans, hawk owls, river otters, turtles, raccoons, armadillos
View multi-million dollar celebrity lakefront homes including "Versaille", largest private residence in America
blurb: Guests take boat tours on the Butler Chain of Lakes, which covers almost 5000 acres and includes 13 lakes linked by canals through cypress trees. The tours feature abundant wildlife such as alligators, birds, and other animals, as well as views of multi-million dollar celebrity homes including the large private residence "Versaille." Private parties and swimming tours of 2 to 4 hours are also available.
